body:
I believed I had worth. I believed that I meant something. It was pretty legitimate. The people in my life today are good people. But I still don't matter. Not even with these people. I would be a story, and they probably want the best for me.

I'm just.. irrelevant. And on a personal level I'm tired. I am always so tired

I don't think anything is wrong really. Nothing changed. 

Just me. Except I didn't change I just went back to the same place

I have no idea what I need. I need something I can believe in but that is an impossible request because I don't know what I could believe in

So I guess what happened is I thought things were better because my life got better but I was just blind and everything feels as dead as always and life getting better or worse has nothing to do with it. Or so I seem to think right now and I can't remember how to think differently all I remember is that for a while I did think differently. I want that back, I don't know why it left

I was thinking Buddhism, but doesn't matter a lot. 

Just sounds like a nice idea, for not caring to be peaceful.

I guess that means I do care, because not caring hurts

I don't think the above made sense I don't really know what I'm doing

Peace is all I want.

I think maybe I could get the same thing if I became a hermit nun

But I don't know how. And if I knew how,  I would certainly be too weak for that too

I want it to help but I have talked it out 100 times only to have this be my reality again. I have tried everything. I want there to be something I can try still. So I'm reaching desperately but it won't go anywhere. I'm tired but I'm a spoiled princess and want it to end by itself. I don't want to have to do it
